entries.title: Long TLT from the NFP close to +3td, with the long end at its 52w floor
entries.trigger: cycle year. The cell is midterm-dead (+0.071%, N=12, 58% hit, t=0.17) and alive outside midterms (+0.978%, N=13, 92% hit, t=2.72; bootstrap P(mean<=0)=0.021, 27x cost). Turns on at the first non-midterm NFP, 2027-01. Re-opens sooner only if a variant independent of the midterm split emerges.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. 2026 is midterm and the next NFP is 2026-09-04 (+10 td), at the horizon cap. Turns on 2027-01.

entries.title: Credit-quality divergence, long LQD against short HYG at joint 52w extremes
entries.trigger: episode count. At the stated tolerances (HYG within 0.5% of its 52w high, LQD within 2% of its 52w low) the joint state has 4 declustered episodes since HYG's 2007 inception: 2018-06-11, 2018-07-20, 2018-09-07 and the currently live 2026-07-22 cluster. TURNS ON at >= 8 declustered episodes spanning >= 3 distinct years excluding 2018. Widening to reach 8 today puts 69 of 88 days in 2018, which is not a sample. Note before re-testing: at h=5 the LQD leg's residual against IEF is +0.000pp, so unless a future instance shows a credit-specific component this is a duration trade wearing a credit label.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. The STATE is live (HYG -0.29% off its 52w high, LQD +0.69% off its 52w low) but the trigger is episode count and it is still 4 declustered instances since 2007.

entries.title: Long SVXY overnight into the CPI print, MOC the eve to MOO on the print
entries.trigger: concentration. The 3-day hold is dead (2021+ beta-neutral residual +0.036% at a 50.0% hit), but the OVERNIGHT alone is the one post-2018 pulse: raw +32.5 bps, +25.4 bps over a tdom-matched non-CPI SVXY overnight, beta-neutral residual +21.5 bps at t 2.88 and a 71.0% hit on N=100. It does not clear cost because 2023 alone contributes 1512 of the 3247 bps total from 12 of 100 events, and the leave-one-year-out floor is 19.7 bps against 8-10 bps all-in for an MOC-to-MOO round trip. TURNS ON when the beta-neutral drop-best-year edge clears 40-50 bps, i.e. 5x cost; it is 19.7 bps today. Re-measure after each new CPI print, since one more non-2023 year of contribution moves the LOYO floor directly.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. No CPI until 2026-09-11, and the LOYO floor is unchanged at 19.7 bps against a 40-50 bp trigger.

entries.title: Long GLD on a miner-led thrust the metal has not joined
entries.trigger: FOUR conditions now, because the three it carried all fired on 2026-08-21 and the idea still died. The original three (GDX 5d rank >= 95 while GLD 5d rank < 95, no CPI or PPI inside the hold, no live GDX position) cleared for the first time and the parent cell reproduced (75 episodes, +0.853% at h=5, excess +0.619pp, 48-27, sign p 0.0101, 28x cost, decluster-stable at min_gap 5/10/21/42). The FOURTH condition, which the entry never encoded, is the trend state of the metal: 2018+ with GLD more than 10% below its 52-week high pays -0.641% over 10 episodes at a 50% hit against +0.844% at a 72% hit for the complement, and 2026-08-21 sat at -16.26%. ADD: GLD 63d rank >= 50 AND GLD within 10% of its 52-week high. Two standing caveats found the same morning that no trigger cures: the dose response runs BACKWARDS on the entry's own axis, since GLD 5d rank [85,95) pays +0.892% against [70,85)'s +0.585% and [50,70)'s +0.702%, so 'the metal has not joined' is not what the cell keys on and the conditioner needs restating; and GDX one-week moves above +10% pay +0.483% at a 51.6% hit against +1.113% at 72.7% below that, so a violent miner thrust is the wrong half. Book-overlap rule to apply every time: GLD's forward return correlates +0.766 with GDX's over the hold (trailing-252d daily corr 0.849), and on the 28 of 75 episodes where GDX mean-reverts GLD pays -0.925% at a 25% hit, so this can never be taken while the book is staged short the miners - adding it to a short NEM leg cancels 82% of the combined position.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: FIRED on all three stated conditions and was KILLED anyway. Trigger rewritten with the missing trend-state rung so it stops firing false. Evidence: a1_c1_gld_miner_thrust.py, a1b_c1_gld_teardown.py, a1c_c1_book_overlap.py.

entries.title: Long XLE on a crude one-day thrust in the 5 to 6 percent band
entries.trigger: the size of the pop, and what is inside the hold. The punch is confined to a band: the [5%,6%) bucket pays +1.109% excess at a 73.7% hit and sign p 0.0025, while today's +6.73% sits in [6%,inf) at +0.619% with no record behind it (59.0% hit, sign p 0.168). In ATR terms today is a 1.43 ATR move, landing in the atr>=1.25 bucket whose h=3 excess is -0.218%; the ATR form only turns positive at >= 1.50 ATR. TURNS ON at a USO one-day pop landing in [5%,6%) AND at least 1.50 ATR, with no CPI or PPI inside the three-session hold (a CPI in the window takes the cell from +0.476% to -1.204%, Welch t -2.28). Standing caveat that survives any trigger: net of XLE's 0.479 crude beta the residual is +0.291% at a 49.3% hit, so this is levered crude and not producer alpha, and the book has been systematically SHORT energy on these days (47 Overbot Vol Spike shorts on USO >= +5% days at avgR +0.29).
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. USO's one-day move was +2.77%, outside the [5%,6%) band and under the 1.50 ATR floor.

entries.title: Long TLT with the whole investment-grade complex pinned at 52w lows
entries.trigger: FRESHNESS, not the price state. At the tight rung (TLT within 0.5% of its 52w low AND IEF within 1.0% AND LQD within 1.0%) the cell pays +0.354pp excess at an 82.4% hit over 17 EPISODE-FIRST days, sign p 0.0101, ex-2022 +0.339% at 90%, local-control t +2.15, and TLT<=0.5% alone is -0.120% at a 50% hit so the three-way join is load-bearing. Later days inside the same episode pay -0.079pp at a 50.0% hit (N=52, sign p 0.67). TURNS ON when the tight rung fires on a day that is the FIRST trigger day in >= 10 trading sessions, long TLT h=1 MOC. Today 2026-08-12 failed only that leg: 6 sessions into an episode that began 2026-08-03. The loose rung (1.0/1.5/1.5) is dead on its own (+0.046pp, Welch t +0.22) and worth nothing as a conditioner on the PPI cell (+0.0036pp, t +0.01), so do not widen it to reach a sample.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. IEF (0.89%) and LQD (0.69%) clear their rungs but TLT is 1.22% above its 52w low against the 0.5% tight rung.

entries.title: Long SPY on a skew spike alone, no volatility condition
entries.trigger: regime, and it is two conditions. pct_rank(^SKEW,5) >= 95 with NO vix condition pays +0.372% excess at h=5 over 185 episodes, 65.4% hit, sign p 0.026, stable to declustering (min_gap 5/10/21/42 -> +0.372/+0.349/+0.359/+0.428) and to dropping the three best months (+0.275%). Adding a low-VIX leg, which is how the cell was first framed, throws away 81 episodes and HALVES the excess to +0.175%. TURNS ON when SPY is more than 1% below its 52w high (that cell N=112, +0.633% excess, sign p 0.014) AND the year is not a midterm (N=89, +0.807%, 74.2% hit, sign p 0.0012). On 2026-08-12 SPY was 0.35% off its high in a midterm year, so both legs failed and the live intersection was N=20 at -0.174%. Caveat before arming: the dip bucket (SPY 5d <= -1%) carries +1.491% excess and plain dip-buying with no skew condition already pays +0.219% over N=511, so price how much of it is the skew and how much is the dip.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: CHECKED, arm CONFIRMED and unchanged. The dip leg went live for the first time (SPY -1.96% off its high, skew 5d rank 97.6) and the cell was re-measured whole: parent dip+skew is 41 episodes, +1.214% at h=5, excess +1.020pp, Welch +2.14, bootstrap P(mean<=0) 0.002, 27-14 sign p 0.030, 61x cost, era-stable at +1.247 pre-2018 and +1.112 after, threshold-stable across skew 90-97 and dip -0.5% to -3.0%, and the skew increment over dip-alone is +0.823pp at Welch t +1.68. The midterm leg is what held it back and it now has a full horizon table behind it: midterm is negative at EVERY horizon (h=1 -0.544 / h=2 -0.846 / h=3 -0.419 / h=5 -0.473 / h=10 -0.185, 8 episodes, 37.5% hit) while non-midterm is positive at every one (h=5 +1.623%, 72.7% hit, sign p 0.0068), so no horizon rescues it. The drag reproduces on three independent parents (-0.618pp on skew alone at Welch -1.78, -0.290pp on dip alone, -0.210pp on all days) and is not confined to 2002 and 2022, so it is a real conditioner rather than a 20-observation slice. Turn-on remains the first non-midterm instance, 2027-01. Evidence: a3_c6_skew_dip.py, a3b_c6_midterm_probe.py.

entries.title: Fade a crude thrust out of a deep base with a macro print inside the hold
entries.trigger: post-2020 episode count. The macro-print-inside-the-hold sub-cell of the USO thrust fade (USO 5d rank >= 90 AND 63d rank <= 20) is 8-1 at h=3 (sign p 0.0154) and 11-2 at h=5 (sign p 0.0069), and 2026-08-12 landed in it. It is a post-hoc split of a dead parent and it inverts by era: h=3 pre-2018 +3.359% against 2018+ -0.465%, and h=5's mean is 96% two episodes (2008-12-11 +13.2%, 2020-04-02 +16.4%) sitting beside a -16.5% from the same 2020 cluster. TURNS ON at >= 8 post-2020 episodes with the 2018+ h=3 mean positive; it is -0.465% on 4 today. Standing caveat: the parent fade is USO's conditional roll cost, since on the identical trigger days short XLE is -0.280% and short XOP -0.413% at h=1 while short USO is +0.394%.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. USO 5d rank 83.7 (needs >= 90) and 63d rank 23.8 (needs <= 20); neither leg fires.

entries.title: Long the medical-device thrust, IHI at a 21d rank of 100 out of a drawdown
entries.trigger: the REFERENCE CLASS, plus freshness. Within IHI the cell looks like a survivor: h=5 +1.499% over 16 episodes at 12-4, excess +1.267pp over its own drift, bootstrap P(mean<=0) 0.0022, positive in 9 of 9 firing years and in both eras (pre-2018 +1.624%, 2018+ +1.338%), monotone in the rank gate and flat across the drawdown gate. It dies to the cross-section: run the identical rule on 27 sector ETFs and Cochran Q is 24.56 on 26 df (p 0.544, I-squared 0.0%) with a fixed-effect common excess of -0.035pp, while permuting the same estimator produces a MAXIMUM of +1.92pp from pure noise against IHI's +1.211pp, i.e. family-wise p 0.9330 and a below-median best-of-27 draw. TURNS ON when the 27-ETF reference class shows real heterogeneity (Cochran Q p < 0.05) with IHI's excess above the permutation max, AND the state fires on an episode-FIRST day: 15 of the 16 measured episodes are depth-1 entries. Two things to fix before any re-test: min_gap 21 declustering already takes the excess to +0.484pp at bootstrap 0.194, and the headline +13.94% thrust was a denominator roll (ret21 jumped 4.90pp on a session price moved +0.18%, because the 21-day reference rolled off a -4.13% bar), so quote a magnitude gate rather than a rank next time. The FADE direction is separately and permanently dead at -0.953% on 5-15.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. IHI's 21d rank is 98.8, not 100, and the reference-class blocker is unchanged.

entries.title: Long China's five-day break inside an intact thrust, FXI while EEM holds
entries.trigger: the residual, then the definition. The tight cell (FXI 5d rank <= 20 while its 21d rank >= 80 and EEM's 5d return is positive) is 5-0 at h=3 at +0.834%, sign p 0.0312 against a coin and 0.0388 against FXI's own 52.2% base rate, but the residual against EEM at the measured 1.025 beta is -0.277% because EEM paid +1.084% on the same windows, so the outright is EM beta with a China label. TURNS ON when the residual against EEM is positive across >= 8 declustered episodes AND the rank-5 cut survives loosening to 25; today the residual is -0.277% and the 25 cut pays -0.003% (30 pays -0.426%). The as-specified joint state has 4 declustered episodes with three inside one two-month window in 2006-07, and the EEM-positive gate puts SPY below its 200d on 0.0% of trigger days against a 19.7% base rate, so a re-test must also show the gate is not simply excluding bear tape.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. FXI's 5d rank is 80.6 and the trigger needs <= 20, so the state is the opposite of the cell.

entries.title: An industry-wide five-day breadth washout, taken with the trend BROKEN instead of intact
entries.trigger: which half of the gate is live, plus an unproven tradeable form. The breadth washout ALONE pays +0.885% at h=5 over 225 episodes (t 2.405) against a +0.280% all-days baseline, and the parent cell is +0.917% over 233 episodes (t 2.589). The whole of that lives in the NOT-INTACT half: adding the intact-63d-uptrend gate takes the cell to -0.789% on 5-8, which is where 2026-08-14 sat (insurer median 63d rank 82.9). TURNS ON when >= 70% of a coherent industry universe sits at a 5-day rank <= 20 while the median 63d rank is BELOW 70, AND a <= 4-name selection rule clears the alphabetical placebo on the LONG side, which has not been tested. That second leg is not optional: on the short side the four alphabetically-first names returned +1.568% against +0.905% for the four most washed, so a selection rule that ignores the signal beat the one that uses it, and the pitch grammar caps an idea at four legs. Standing caveat that survives any trigger: the reference class across 10 industry groups gives Cochran Q 6.49 on 9 df (p 0.690, I-squared 0.0%) with a common excess of +0.819pp, so this is an any-industry effect and no industry label carries information. Note also that the intact-gated cell is NOT a bad-tape artifact in reverse: its trigger days sit below SPY's 200d only 4.5% of the time against a 25.4% base rate, so the gate selects good tape and the cell still loses in it.
entries.note: 2026-08-21: CLOSED, do not re-open. The entry's own untested leg (a <=4-name LONG selection rule against the alphabetical placebo) was tested on banks at 92.3% breadth with a median 63d rank of 69.8, and the four most-washed names LOSE to the four alphabetically-first at every horizon 1-10 (-0.117pp at h=5, -0.094 at h=1, -0.162 at h=2, -0.089 at h=3, -0.081 at h=10), with all 11 names (+0.826%) and the strongest 4 (+0.872%) also beating the selection rule. The alphabetical placebo is now 7-for-8. Three further kills landed on the same run: the reference class agrees for a third independent time (Cochran Q 5.88 on 10 df, I-squared 0.0%, banks rank 3 of 11, P(max group excess >= banks) = 0.891); the trend gate does not filter at the live reading, since walking the median-63d threshold gives +0.344pp at the 70 line against +0.348pp for NO GATE AT ALL; and the basket correlates 0.926 with XLF at 1.9x cost full-history and 0x from 2018. Evidence: c7_banks_broken_long.py.

entries.title: Long TLT on the NOVEMBER month-position effect
entries.trigger: the CALENDAR, and this one parks to a date rather than to a level. At matched trading-day-of-month 4-12, h=10 lag-1, November pays +1.590% over 24 years at a 20-4 year record (sign p 0.00077) and ranks 1 of 12 months. It is the live sibling of the August cell that died on 2026-08-17: August is 2018-2025 -0.013% at 4 of 8 years, November is 2018-2025 +2.093% at 8 for 8 (sign p 0.0039) and 2021-2025 +2.325% at 5 for 5. Charged in full for the 12-month scan it came out of, Bonferroni gives 0.0093. The duration-neutral residual against IEF at the measured 1.914 beta is +0.462% full-sample and +0.358% for 2018+, so it is not purely a levered-IEF trade. TURNS ON in the entry window of trading days 4 to 12 of November 2026, roughly 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-17. Before it trades, two debts: check the rate regime first, since the August version died precisely on the rising-yield side (+0.496% rising against +1.409% falling) and a bond-bull proxy can migrate month and still be a bond-bull proxy; and re-run the month-of-year table on data through October so the 8-for-8 is not being read at its own peak.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. Parks to the entry window of trading days 4-12 of November 2026, roughly 2026-11-05.

entries.title: Short SPY with the index at a 52w high while the long end sits at a 52w low
entries.trigger: COST on the de-concentrated form. The joint state (SPY within 0.5% of its 52w high AND TLT within 1% of its 52w low) is live today at -0.20% and 0.15%. Its h=5 short side is 9-2 with sign p 0.0327, the only pulse in the cross-asset conditioner lane on 2026-08-17. TURNS ON when the de-concentrated form clears 5x cost: dropping the top 2 episodes (2018-10-03, 2021-02-24, together 96% of the +7.75pp total) leaves +0.039% per episode over the remaining 8, which is 1.3x a 3 bp round trip. Two standing caveats that survive any trigger: the sign INVERTS one horizon earlier at h=3 (-0.242% on 3-7, sign p 0.945), so h=5 is a knife edge rather than a plateau; and the threshold grid decays monotonically as the TLT rung loosens (+1.157 / +0.775 / +0.345 / +0.031), which says the level of the gate is doing the work rather than the joint state. The two legs are near-independent (corr 0.176). Re-measure after each new instance of the joint state; two more episodes of the observed size move the de-concentrated mean directly.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. SPY is 1.96% below its 52w high against a 0.5% rung, so the joint state is not live.

entries.title: Long TLT into the month-end close, ungated, entered nine sessions before it
entries.trigger: DISTANCE FROM THE 52-WEEK LOW, not the calendar. The anchor itself is the strongest duration cell measured in this repo: long TLT entered MOC nine sessions before the month's last trading-day close, exit at that close, pays +0.540% over 288 anchors at t=3.88, +0.391% at t=2.85 once demeaned by month, with an exit-offset placebo ladder that decays monotonically from +0.540% at the true month-end close to -0.229% ten sessions past it (a real ladder result rather than the plateau that killed the Jackson Hole and August seasonal anchors) and a flat regime profile. What blocks it is where TLT sits: within the cell, forward return regresses POSITIVELY on distance from the 52w low at +0.126pp per 1% off (t=+2.18) while the unconditional gradient runs the other way (-0.009, t=-2.55); the >3%-off complement pays +1.129% at a 72.5% hit and t=3.29, and the within-1% bucket that contains today pays +0.189% on a 4-5 record. TURNS ON at a month-end-minus-9 anchor with TLT more than 3% above its 52-week low. Two debts before it trades even then: it must be re-derived FORWARD rather than from the 2,415-cell grid it was found in (that grid's best occupant sits at familywise p=0.060, suggestive rather than clean), and the oversold gate must stay OFF, since adding it only contributes +0.394pp at Welch t=+1.15 and Spearman between the gate variable and the forward return is -0.074.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS twice over. August's ME-9 anchor was 2026-08-18, already gone, and TLT is 1.22% above its 52w low against the >3% trigger.

entries.title: Long SPY on a volatility pop inside an already-calm tape
entries.trigger: the INCREMENT over calm tape, not the level. The three-condition cell (VIX 21-day rank <= 25 AND VIX up >= 5% on the day AND SPY down less than 0.75%) pays +0.874% at h=10 over 59 declustered episodes at a 71.2% hit, and ex-2020 it still pays +0.727%. That looks strong only because it is scored against zero. Its own regime control, calm tape alone (VIX 21-day rank <= 25), pays +0.479% over 300 episodes, so the Welch t of the difference is +1.09; against the local +/-126td control it is +1.38, and against 'calm tape plus a pop, no spot condition' it is +0.88. TURNS ON when that increment over calm-tape-alone reaches Welch t >= 2.0 at h=10, which needs roughly +0.72pp of separation at today's episode count or the current +0.395pp gap surviving to about 150 episodes. Re-measure after each new instance, since the state fires roughly monthly.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. VIX's 21d rank is 40.9 against the <= 25 calm-tape leg, despite the +7.52% pop.

entries.title: Long gold on an unconfirmed rate rise, with both dials at force
entries.trigger: the YIELD MAGNITUDE, not the rank. The pitched rank form is dead (knife edge at exactly 21 sessions: the 10/13/15/18-day lookbacks are all wrong-signed at h=1, the sign flips between the 15 and 18-day forms of the identical rule, and the wrong-signed side is better populated at N=52 against 47). The one cell with both dials at force survives that ladder: DX 21d rank <= 15 AND a 21-session yield rise >= +0.20pt pays +0.551% at h=1 over 16 episodes, 12-4, sign p 0.038, and +1.126% at h=3 (t=2.19). TURNS ON when both legs are live simultaneously; today clears the dollar at rank 14.3 and misses the yield leg by half, +0.108pt against +0.20pt. Two debts before it ever trades: it is search-contaminated at P(grid max t >= 2.06) = 0.937 over the 168-mask grid it came out of, so it needs re-deriving forward rather than from that grid; and the parent's dose response runs BACKWARDS (+0.432 / +0.384 / +0.225% at yield floors of +0.05 / +0.10 / +0.20pt), so the forced-dial cell has to explain why it is the exception to its own parent's gradient rather than the top of it. Standing pass worth keeping: the trigger is NOT a gold-bull selector (GLD above its 200d on 70.2% of trigger episodes against a 66.1% base rate) and day-1-of-run entries pay +0.543% at t=2.89 against -0.664% at day 16+, so freshness is on this cell's side rather than against it.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. The dollar leg clears easily (DX 21d rank 3.2 against <= 15) but the yield leg is a +0.04pt 21-session rise against the +0.20pt floor.

entries.title: Long technology against healthcare after a rotation gap, in calm near-high tape
entries.trigger: NEW EPISODES OUTSIDE THE 2026 CLUSTER, and the arithmetic is exact. The subclass matching today (one-day XLV minus XLK gap >= 3.0pp, SPY within 3% of its 52w high, SPY Wilder-14 ATR under 1.2% of price) pays +0.889% at h=3 over 21 episodes, and the rotation trigger genuinely beats an ignorant 'any big tech-down day in the same tape' placebo (-0.066 / +0.036 / -0.164 / +0.321 at h=1/2/3/5), which is the one test it passed. It dies on concentration: the top 2 episodes are 96% of the h=3 total and both are 2026 prints, ex-2026 is 7-7 at -0.599% and negative at 5 of 6 horizons, and the by-year table runs -1.33 (2024) / -1.08 (2025) / +3.86 (2026). TURNS ON when the h=3 subclass drop-best-episode mean reaches +0.50% at N >= 24 with a record of 15-9 or better, which needs three new subclass episodes, all three winners, landing OUTSIDE the current 2026 rotation cluster. The state fires roughly 7x a year now, so this is measurable within months. Two caveats that survive any trigger: the apparent midterm-year conditioner (+3.553% against -0.751%) is that same 2026 cluster relabelled at 7 of its 8 episodes, so do not read it as a cycle effect; and the NAKED long XLK beats the pair at h=5 and h=7, so if this ever arms it arms as an outright, not as a pair.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. Today's one-day XLV-minus-XLK gap is -1.58pp, the wrong direction for a >= +3.0pp trigger.

entries.title: Short the dollar on a rate rise the currency does not confirm
entries.trigger: COST on an honest magnitude floor. The rank form (TNX 21d rank >= 65 while DX 21d rank <= 20) pays +0.234% at h=5 over 56 episodes at Welch t +1.68 against its own drift, but the exact sign test never clears 0.25 at any gap or horizon, and the 21-session lookback is the single positive point in a ladder whose 10/13/15/18-day neighbours are all negative at both h=3 and h=5 with MORE observations. Restated as a magnitude floor rather than a rank, TNX 21d level rise >= +0.10pt pays 3.9 bps at h=5, which is 2.6x the 1.5 bp DX-futures round trip. TURNS ON at 5x cost, i.e. 7.5 bps on the magnitude-floor form. Structural blocker to fix first: the thesis is entirely a size-of-repricing story and neither dial has a dose response (yield-rise buckets +0.289 / +0.119 / +0.253%, dollar-fall buckets +0.816 / +0.225 / +0.200%, both non-monotone with the middle bucket weakest), so a bigger sample alone will not rescue it - the mechanism has to be restated. Search-priced at P(grid max t >= 1.73) = 0.810.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. ^TNX's 21d rank is 50.0 against the >= 65 leg; the dollar half is live and the rate half is not.

entries.title: Long crude through Jackson Hole, entered six sessions before the conference
entries.trigger: CONCENTRATION, and separately the state XLE is in. This is the first event anchor in this repo to SURVIVE the offset placebo ladder: long USO at JH-6 ranks 1 of 16 at h=10 (CL=F also 1 of 16, XLE 3 of 16), pays +2.145% over 20 anchors against an anchor-tdom-weighted unconditional August expectation of +0.632%, and beats the plain tdom-matched August control of +0.593%. It is also not the USO roll artifact that killed the thrust-fade family, since USO-minus-CL=F on the anchors is +0.049pp against an unconditional roll drag of -0.302pp and CL=F carries the same +1.628%. TURNS ON when the drop-best-3 h=10 excess reaches +0.50pp: it is -0.056pp today, so three of twenty years (2015, 2007, 2021) are the entire effect and removing them leaves exactly the unconditional late-August window. That needs new winning anchors outside those three years, one per August, so this is a multi-year park. SECOND leg, and it is a state condition that can change within a year: do not take it with XLE within 5% of its 52-week high. 0 of 26 anchors have ever combined that with a USO 63d rank under 40, which is 2026-08-20's state, and the single anchor where XLE sat at its high (2016) is the worst episode in the sample at USO -10.97% / CL=F -10.49%. Standing caveats: XLE's midterm cell is wrong-signed at -0.097% at h=10 while USO's is +0.590% against non-midterm +2.664%, so the vehicle and the cycle interact; and the pitched USO h=10 cell ranks 2 of 35 in the vehicle x horizon grid it came from (excess sd 0.714pp). The book has ZERO energy signals in any JH-6..+4 window across the 4,741-row ledger, so there is no conflict and no confirmation either.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS on both legs. The JH-6 anchor was 2026-08-20, one session gone, and the entry's own second condition forbids the trade with XLE within 5% of its 52w high - XLE closed AT its high (0.00%). Re-confirmed independently this morning inside the cross-asset opex sweep, where the XLE August cell also split +0.31% in the hot-21d half against +2.74% in the cool half and today's 21d is +7.7%.

entries.title: Short TLT after a big up day from inside the 52-week low zone
entries.trigger: THE PARENT'S SIGN AT THE NEXT RUNG DOWN. The cell as specified (TLT 1-day return >= +1.5% while within 4% of its trailing-252 low) passed more tests than anything else this morning: +0.638% at h=2 over 17 declustered episodes, 13-4, sign p 0.0245, bootstrap P(mean<=0) 0.000, local +/-126td control edge +0.603pp, tdom-matched +0.702pp, month-matched +0.642pp, LOYO floor +0.536%, 21x a 3 bp round trip, worst episode -1.07%, and it passes the bond-bull fossil test in reverse (16 of 17 triggers are in the rising-yield half by construction, but the rising-regime all-days short control is -0.032%, so the regime does not explain it). The duration translation is clean rather than a TLT quirk: TLT excess +0.673pp against IEF +0.337pp, a ratio of 2.00 against a daily-sd ratio of 2.10. TURNS ON when the [1.0%, 1.5%) thrust band stops being significantly wrong-signed: it pays -0.241% at h=2 over 26 episodes at a 30.8% hit (sign p 0.986) today, and the loosened 1.0% parent loses -0.165% over 33 at a 36.4% hit (sign p 0.960), so the positive sign is manufactured by the rung. The full ladder is non-monotone and peaks exactly at the pitched value ([1.25,1.5) +0.058%, >=1.5% +0.638%, >=1.75% +0.507%, >=2.0% +0.267%). SECOND debt, independent of the first: the mechanism has to start when the trade does. Per-session increments from the entry close run +0.133pp at a 52.9% hit (session +1), +0.505pp (session +2), -0.128pp, then -0.432pp at a 29.4% hit (session +4), so the whole cell is one non-adjacent session and the position hands it back by day four. A short-covering-rally story predicts the fade begins at entry. Search priced on the 125-cell grid actually walked (5 thrust rungs x 5 low rungs x 5 horizons, |t| scored so both signs are charged): P(grid max |t| >= 3.30) = 0.167. Concentration note for the re-test: 2022 is 7 of 17 episodes and ex-2021-2023 leaves N=6 at +0.539%. Today 2026-08-20 was inside historical support on both dimensions (35th percentile by distance from the low, 50th by thrust size), so this is a definition problem and not a today-is-unusual problem.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. TLT's one-day move was -0.82% against the >= +1.5% thrust rung.

entries.title: Short regional banks against the big-bank index on a breadth washout
entries.trigger: COST once the crisis years come out. Short KRE against long XLF on the bank-breadth washout (>=70% of an 11-name complex at a 5d rank <= 20 with the median 63d rank intact) pays +0.702% at h=3 on 16-9 and +1.370% at h=10 on 16-9, and beta-neutralising does not explain it (KRE-on-XLF beta 0.97/0.98, residual +0.698%/+1.353%). TURNS ON at 5x cost ex-crisis: dropping 2008/2009/2020 leaves +0.102% at h=3 over 18 episodes = 1.5x a 7 bp two-leg round trip, and +0.114% at h=10 = 1.6x, so the trigger is +0.35% at h=3 on the ex-crisis subset. Era split runs +1.219% pre-2018 (t 2.25) against +0.043% after (t 0.06) and top-2 episodes are 64% of the h=3 total, so this needs new modern episodes rather than a wider net. TWO PASSES worth keeping, both unusual: the tape over-selection check runs the RIGHT way for once (trigger days sit below SPY's 200d 20.8% of the time against a 25.4% base rate), and the alphabetical placebo FAILED to kill for the first time in this repo - the signal-picked four names beat BAC/C/GS/JPM by +0.589pp at h=3 and +1.333pp at h=10 market-relative. STANDING BLOCKER that survives any trigger: the outright short is dead (short KRE ex-2008/2009/2011/2020 is -0.950% at h=10 on 5-12) and so is the XLF short (-0.9 / -22.5 / -51.1 bps at h=3/5/10), so if this ever arms it arms as the PAIR. And the reference class says the bank label carries nothing: across 12 industry groups Cochran Q is 6.65 on 11 df with a dispersion ratio of 0.71 and P(max group excess >= banks) = 0.761, so any re-test has to show the pair form works on OTHER industries too or explain why regionals-versus-money-centres is structurally special.
entries.note: 2026-08-21 verdict: PASS. The breadth state IS live (92.3% of the complex at a 5d rank <= 20) but the trigger is a cost threshold on history (+0.35% at h=3 ex-crisis) that one new episode cannot move. The LONG side of the same state was tested today and CLOSED - see the industry-breadth entry.

entries.title: Long high yield across the Jackson Hole speech, entered five sessions before it
entries.trigger: THREE numbers, and it needs all three. The record is the best thing in the Jackson Hole lane: 17-2 at h=8 to h=10 over 19 anchors, era-stable at +0.960% pre-2018 on 10-1 and +0.386% from 2018 on 7-1, top-3 episodes only 10-19% of the total, 24x a 4 bp round trip, mean over sd 0.65. It fails on leg attribution, on the null, and on the cycle. (1) The SPY-beta-hedged residual excess must reach +0.20pp, i.e. 5x cost; it is +0.082pp, and over the same 19 anchors HYG's August-tdom excess of +0.345pp at h=10 sits BELOW SPY's +0.700pp, so credit currently SUBTRACTS 0.355pp from an equity leg the registry closed on 2026-08-18. (2) The sign test against HYG's OWN August-tdom up-rate of 75.2% must clear 0.05; it is 0.1147, and the 17-2 headline p=0.0004 is scored against a coin, which is the wrong null for a drifting instrument. (3) The midterm cell must stop being negative; it is -0.377% at h=10, a sixth independent reproduction of the JH midterm inversion, with 4 of 6 vehicles negative. STANDING BLOCKER that survives all three and probably ends it: JH-5 IS the August opex close in 21 of 26 years, so this anchor is not distinct from either the opex anchor (closed on US equities in both directions 2026-08-20) or the JH anchor (closed on five classes), and it can never be pitched as a separate discovery. Note also that the mechanism is falsified inside its own window: the premium-build story predicts a negative pre-speech leg and the h<=4 class mean excess is +0.010pp, with the offset ladder paying about the same entering 12 sessions early or 3 sessions AFTER the speech.
entries.note: Parked 2026-08-21 as the one park-worthy near-miss of an 11-candidate all-kill sweep.
